name: Stock
summary: Keeps the materials a construction business buys in stock: reads stock on hand in Xero, drafts a purchase order for each item at or below its reorder level, queues the award for approval, and checks supplier bills against their purchase orders. Crons read and draft; a person approves every award.

job-materials.evidence: 22 of the 29 stock calls read describe buying materials for jobs

covered_by.stock-count: stock-levels (reads stock on hand in Xero; counts kept outside Xero are not read)
covered_by.check-price-availability: po-draft (unit price from the Xero item)
covered_by.update-stock: stock-levels (the next read shows the new on-hand)
covered_by.record-keeping: bill-match (a log of each bill's match)

yard-stock.evidence: 3 of the 29 stock calls read describe a yard or storeroom

crons.name: stock-levels
crons.summary: Reads stock on hand in Xero and raises a request for each reordered item at or below its level.

crons.name: po-draft
crons.summary: Drafts a purchase order in Xero for each new request and queues its award for approval.

crons.name: bill-match
crons.summary: Compares supplier bills with open purchase orders from the same supplier and logs matches and differences.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: a read of stock, contacts, purchase orders or bills, and a purchase order in DRAFT status. Setting a purchase order AUTHORISED is a live operation and waits for a person.

xero.covers: stock on hand, supplier contact lookup, draft purchase order, award (AUTHORISED), and open purchase orders and supplier bills read

gaps: Sending a purchase order to the supplier (send-order) is not built: Xero's API returns a purchase order as a PDF but does not email it, and the mailbox adapter is not part of this workflow.
Allocating materials to a job (allocate-to-job) is not built: the Xero purchase order carries a request reference, not a job, so no job link is written.
Receiving goods (receive-goods) is not built: no Xero receiving operation is mapped, so deliveries are checked and receipted in Xero by hand.
Buildxact has no mapped operations in the kit beyond sign-in, so no adapter is built for it.
MYOB's inventory adjustments (the stock-count step on its docs) are not wired to this workflow; it has no adapter here.
ServiceM8, JackApp, Simpro, FoxIQ, IP Solution, Buildertrend and Dropbox are named on the calls but have no mapped stock operations for this job, so no adapter is built.
Reorder levels and supplier emails come from settings. An item without a rule is never reordered.
A skipped request (no unit price, no supplier contact, or a rejected award) stays until someone clears it; the CRM shell has no screen for that yet.
An award that is still pending when its item comes back above its level is closed by the stock check; reject that award in the shell if the stock is no longer needed.
Xero purchase orders have no approval step of their own; the approval is the CRM shell's.
Bill matching uses supplier and total only, because the docs do not describe matching a bill to a purchase order number.
The kit's capability list has no purchase-order capability, so this workflow lists orders.list and products.list instead.
The Xero adapter is docs-only until a Xero demo company proves it.

evidence.calls: 29 construction stock calls read: 25 describe how they track stock and order materials, 22 for jobs and 3 for yard or storeroom stock
evidence.platforms: the Xero purchase order and bill operations are mapped in the kit; Buildxact and MYOB appear in construction-x-stock-platforms.json, but neither has a mapped operation for this workflow's steps
